topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Well, t'was a strange morn when I met Will in the village. We grew up side by side, sowing the same fields, sharing the same rains. I thought, surely he'd remember the time we hid in the barn, or the winter we caught the fox. But he just smiled, polite, and said he must've moved on before he knew me. I nodded, glanced at the soil, dug my boots into the earth. It's the way of things, I suppose. Some roots run deep, others wash away with the spring floods. The land stays, the seasons turn, and life goes on, doesn’t it?
